community.feedbackNote: Bug, idea, complaint? It goes straight to the developer. Include what you were doing.

tips: Aim down sights (right mouse) for tighter spread. Hip-fire is for close range.
Headshots deal extra damage on every weapon. Aim for the upper body and let recoil climb.
Throw a smoke (Q) to cross an open lane. Enemies can't see through it, and neither can you.
Frags (G) bounce. Cook one off a wall to clear a corner without stepping out.
In Domination, capturing is faster with teammates on the node. A contested node doesn't move.
You heal after a few seconds out of fire. Break line of sight instead of trading at low health.
Reload behind cover. An empty magazine in the open is the most common way to lose a duel.
Crouching (C) steadies your aim, but a crouched player is easy to flank.

patches.title: Melee, prone and a sharper look
notes: Melee (V): a quick strike. From behind it takes an enemy down in one; from the front it takes two.
Prone (Z): lie down and crawl. Steadier aim and harder to spot, but slow. Jump, sprint or crouch to get up.
Marksman scope: the aim drifts while scoped; hold Shift to hold your breath and steady it. Enemies see a glint when you aim their way.
Weapons kick with real weight, every third round is a tracer, bullets leave marks and chip concrete, brick and wood, and ring off metal.
Haze over the ground, dust in the air, sun shafts on High, and dirt at the foot of walls. Looking into the sun no longer washes out the screen.
F1 opens a tuning panel: frame graph, draw calls, weapon feel sliders and a time-to-kill table.

patches.title: Smoother starts, safer keys
notes: No more freezes in the first seconds of a match: the map, soldiers and effects are prepared behind the Deploying card.
Smoother firefights: enemies stepping back into view no longer hitch, and the crosshair and bullet impacts cost far less each frame.
Ctrl+W no longer closes the game by accident: the game goes fullscreen with the keyboard locked when you play (Chrome, Edge; Settings → Game), and closing the tab mid-match asks first.

patches.title: See the enemy, feel the fight
notes: Enemies have a red outline light and teammates a soft blue one, a little stronger at a distance, so soldiers stand out against any wall or sky.
Your weapon sways with fast turns and settles; a small view punch on every kill.
Eliminations burst with sparks and a flash (no gore), so a kill reads from across the map.
Taking damage pulses the screen edge; at low health a heartbeat pulse, and on Medium/High the colour drains.

patches.title: Minimap and a new look
notes: Minimap (top-left): the map from above, turned to your view; teammates always shown, and enemies show where they fire. The radar sweep reward now lights up the minimap.
New lighting: a time of day per map (Alder Street in late-afternoon sun), long shadows and softer shade instead of flat light.
Cinematic look on Medium and High: colour grading, vignette and film grain; High adds ambient occlusion (soft contact shadows).
Combat feel: dust and sparks where bullets hit (yours and theirs), a muzzle light on every shot, spent cases, camera shake from hits and nearby blasts.
Weapons have real metal and wood finishes.

patches.title: Streaks, awards and map vote
notes: Zoom while aiming: the mouse wheel steps through each weapon's zoom levels (rifles up to 2×, the marksman rifle 4×/6×/8×), and the mouse slows with the zoom for precise headshots.
Kill-streak rewards, earned without dying: 3 kills a radar sweep that shows your team every enemy, 5 kills a full resupply, 7 kills armor for 10 seconds.
End-of-match awards: Sharpshooter, Unstoppable, Long shot, Objective and Grenadier.
Vote for the next map on the results screen (keys 1–3).

patches.title: Help
notes: New Help screen in the main menu: basics, your current controls, how each mode scores, movement (slide, mantle, tactical sprint), every weapon and when it unlocks, XP and unlocks, fixes for common problems, and a direct line to the developer.
Keys show as ← → and Esc instead of their code names.

patches.title: Faster on your feet
notes: Mantle: jump while moving forward at waist-to-chest-high cover (0.5–1.3 m) to climb over it in one move.
Tactical sprint: double-tap sprint to run at 9 m/s for up to 3 seconds, weapon lowered, then a 4 second cooldown.
Turn with the arrow keys (rebindable): works when a laptop touchpad switches off while you hold movement keys.
Domination: "+2 kill" and "+1 node" pop up when a team scores, and the scoreboard shows points from kills and from nodes.

patches.title: Domination fix
notes: Domination: held nodes score 1 point every 10 seconds (was every second, then 5), and kills score 2. Standing on nodes alone no longer races to 200 in a few minutes.
The score bar says what the target is ("first to 200 points" / "first to 75 kills") and, in Domination, how points are made.

patches.title: Alder Street and a real arsenal
notes: New map: Alder Street, a harbour town. Walk into the houses, hold the upstairs windows, fight over the fountain square.
Choose your map on the Play screen (or Any map).
Real soldiers: Aegis and Ember uniforms, full-body animation, and the head you see is the head you hit.
New guns: Varga 47 (hard-hitting rifle, level 7) and Marlowe Sawn-off (secondary shotgun, level 9). Every gun has a real model.
Halberd MR: a real 4x scope. Headshot kills now land with a flash and their own sound.
Maps look real: textured streets, walls and containers under a proper sky; Saltline Depot got its own look.

patches.title: Domination
notes: New playlist: Domination. Hold relay nodes A, B and C on Relay Yard and Saltline Depot.
Nodes show as rings and light beams on the map and as badges in the score bar.
Bots now go for nodes their team doesn't hold.
Comms screen: patch notes and a feedback form.

patches.title: Static on the line
notes: New front end: separate Play, Loadout, Career, Squad, Intel and Settings screens.
The story so far: the Relay, the Blackout Winter, Aegis Directive vs Ember Syndicate.
You now join only when you press DEPLOY. Esc opens a pause menu.
You spawn facing into the map, not at the wall.
Report players from the scoreboard. Reports are reviewed by a person.
Enemies you can't see are no longer sent to your game (anti-wallhack).

patches.title: Ranks and squads
notes: Levels, weapon levels and unlocks. Daily orders give bonus XP.
Friend codes, recent players and invite links: squads join the same team.
Text chat with a filter, team chat and mute.

patches.title: Saltline Depot
notes: New map: Saltline Depot, a shipping depot at dusk.
Attachments and perks for your loadout.
Frag and smoke grenades.
